observations: The page number «102» stands at the head of the page, centred, with a rule below it. The page has no signature. L01 completes the sentence that ends p. 101 (JP2 0133, L37), «Es gehört wohl die Methode Kh.’s zu der von Regiomontan (l. c.) genannten». A wider space separates L07 from L08.
L01-L03: Regiomontanus's words, in italics, quoted from the place of p. 99 (JP2 0131, L09; «l. c.»).

L09-L18 and N01. Checked against Nallino: II, 297-307 are the «Tabulae spuriae», and p. 299 is the «rosa astrologica». No reference to the note is printed in the text; see the critical note. II, 188 holds the «Tabula revolutionum annorum Romanorum», whose collected years go from 20 to 200, the single years from 1 to 20, the values in «tempora ascensionum», as L29-L33 say.
L21-L22: the heading of the closing chapter, in bold, centred, with the reference to the table below it in smaller type.

L34-L39. Checked: with al-Khwārizmī's year, Brahmagupta's 1 577 916 450 000 days in 4 320 000 000 years, 365.2584375 days (p. 42, JP2 0074), a year exceeds 365 days by 6h 12m 9s; 30 years exceed 30 × 365 days by 7d 18h 4.5m, 5 years 5 × 365 days by 1d 7h 0.8m, together 9d 1h 5.3m: «7d 18h 4m», «1d 7h 1m», «9d 1h 5m». The table thus counts the excess over years of 365 days; from 4 January 962 to 4 January 997 the Julian calendar counts 35 × 365 days and 9 leap days, so that the sun returns to its place of the birth 1h 5m after the same hour of 4 January 997. The values of Table 115 are to be compared with the table.

L27: «Vom», the m damaged, so that it looks like «ın»; L06: «der verschiedenen Aspekten», the plural in -en, as printed. L10: «158r», «158v», the letters raised; L38-L39: «7d 18h 4m» and the like, the letters raised.

Spaced type, marked {sp:}: «Kh.», «Björnbo», «Maslama», «Batt.», «Nallino»; italics: the Latin of L01-L03, «Explicit ezich,», «Tabulae spuriae», «anni collecti», «Beispiel :», «anni deceni», «anni singulares».
The colons, semicolons and the question mark stand after the thin space of the edition (8-12 px measured).
copy_matter: A diagonal stroke of ink across «mit» in L15, drawn by hand from above the end of «Zusammenhang» down to the right, in this copy. Not part of the edition.

critical_notes.evidence: the note 1, «Ed. Nallino, II, 299», the page of the «rosa astrologica» among the «Tabulae spuriae», has no reference in the text; it belongs to the second table «als astrologische Rose» among the «Tabulae spuriae Batt.’s»
